title: Custom fields
description: Fields the group adds to its items, such as a license plate or a lens mount. A field's type never changes; its name and options can.

list.loadError: Could not load the custom fields.

dialog.description: A name and a type. Each name is used once in the group, and the type cannot change later.
dialog.removedOptions_one: Saving clears the removed options on {{count}} item.
dialog.removedOptions_other: Saving clears the removed options on {{count}} items.
dialog.limit: A group keeps at most {{count}} custom fields. Delete a field before you add another.

validation.nameTaken: Another field of the group has this name.
validation.optionRequired: Enter a label or remove the option.
validation.optionDuplicate: Each option needs its own label.
validation.optionsTooMany: A field has at most {{max}} options.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?

delete.inUse_other: {{count}} items have a value for this field. Deleting the field deletes their values.
delete.changed: The field's values changed meanwhile. Check the new count and confirm again.
